findings.evidence: Line 51 `theorem range_kaehler_map_localization (S : Submonoid A) [IsLocalization S B]` is already general in `B`; lines 80 and 105 specialize it. `grep` hits: `code/TauCeti/FieldTheory/FunctionField/Place/Adic.lean:176: instance : IsLocalization.AtPrime ((adic k F p).integers) p.asIdeal`; `code/TauCeti/FieldTheory/FunctionField/HolomorphyRing/Localization.lean:62: (ofField F (Submonoid.powers x) hx : Set F)`; `mathlib/Mathlib/RingTheory/Localization/AsSubring.lean:134: theorem ofField_eq : ofField K S hS = subalgebra K S hS` (propositional, so the coerced types differ); `mathlib/Mathlib/RingTheory/LocalProperties/Submodule.lean:27-46` is the family idiom the proof itself calls.
findings.fix: Quantify over a family, mirroring `Submodule.mem_of_localization_maximal`: `(Aₚ : ∀ (P : Ideal A) [P.IsMaximal], Type*)` with `[CommRing (Aₚ P)] [Algebra A (Aₚ P)] [Algebra R (Aₚ P)] [Algebra (Aₚ P) F]`, the scalar towers, and `[IsLocalization.AtPrime (Aₚ P) P]`; state the RHS as `ω ∈ ((map R R (Aₚ P) F).restrictScalars A).range`. findings.issue: The local condition is pinned to `let B := Localization.subalgebra F P.primeCompl …` (also at line 105 in `existsUnique_kaehler_preimage_iff`), although `range_kaehler_map_localization` is general in `B`. The repo's local rings inside `F` are different terms — `(adic k F p).integers` (`Place/Adic.lean:176`, an `IsLocalization.AtPrime`) and `Localization.subalgebra.ofField` (`HolomorphyRing/Localization.lean:62`) — and no transport lemma across `Ω[B⁄R] ≅ Ω[B'⁄R]` is provided, so the cited downstream consumer cannot apply the criterion without redoing the localization comparison.

findings.evidence: Lines 107-110 contain the whole proof as a local `have`. `grep -r 'IsLocalizedModule.*injective' mathlib/Mathlib` returns only `injective_iff_isRegular` (`Mathlib/Algebra/Module/LocalizedModule/Basic.lean:552`), `injective_of_map_zero`, `map_injective`, `smul_injective` — no torsion-free version, so the general lemma is absent from pinned Mathlib and the specialized one is absent from the post-PR surface.
findings.fix: Export it, e.g. `theorem injective_kaehler_map_fractionRing [Module.IsTorsionFree A Ω[A⁄R]] : Function.Injective (map R R A F)`, and derive the `∃!` form from it. Better still, state the general fact (`[IsLocalizedModule S f]`, `S ≤ R⁰`, `[Module.IsTorsionFree R M]` ⇒ `Injective f`) in a general `IsLocalizedModule` file and specialize here.
findings.issue: Injectivity of `map R R A F` under `[Module.IsTorsionFree A Ω[A⁄R]]` is claimed as a result of the file in the module docstring (line 21: "the map `Ω[A⁄R] → Ω[F⁄R]` is injective. Thus regular differentials can be treated as rational differentials") but exists only as the `have hinj` inside `existsUnique_kaehler_preimage_iff`. Its statement mentions only Mathlib types and its proof does not use this file's subject, yet a consumer wanting `Ω[A⁄R]` as a submodule of `Ω[F⁄R]` must rederive it or route circuitously through the `∃!` iff.

summary: The two consumer-facing criteria hardcode one localization model (`Localization.subalgebra`) even though the underlying theorem is general in `B`, so the repo's existing local rings inside `F` cannot use them. The injectivity fact the module docstring advertises is buried in a proof instead of exported.
